summary: LiveRamp Holdings, Inc. disclosed entry into a definitive merger agreement with MMS USA Holdings, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Publicis Groupe S.A., whereby Merger Sub will merge into LiveRamp. Per share price and implied enterprise value are not explicitly stated in the excerpt. The LiveRamp Board unanimously determined the merger is fair and in the best interests of stockholders, resolved to recommend stockholders approve the deal. The merger is subject to stockholder approval, regulatory clearances, and customary closing conditions; no break fee or termination date is mentioned. Watch for stockholder vote timing and antitrust review in the US/Europe.
